statement: Represent the Philippines as one national region with shared PHL_WTR_SUR and PHL_WTR_GWT pools; the eight LNDAGRPHLC classes are coefficient classes, not basins or aquifers.
rationale: Matches the actual one-region model topology and avoids inventing absent transfer, basin or aquifer structure.
notes: No local-scarcity claim follows from a national cap.

statement: Use the ERA5 1991-2020 national precipitation climatology as the 2020 normal for rebasing inherited hydrology.
rationale: Provides a current internally consistent 30-year national normal; ERA5 is reanalysis rather than the PAGASA gauge authority.
notes: 2024-2025 provisional annual data are retained only as context.

statement: Install one SSP2-4.5 ensemble-median precipitation pathway as the RCP4.5-equivalent central path.
rationale: SSP2-4.5 shares the 4.5 W/m2 forcing class requested but is not the identical RCP4.5 socioeconomic or model experiment.
notes: The user chooses any additional scenarios; none are preinstalled.

statement: Retain CCKP p10 and p90 values in the evidence snapshot but do not create predefined model scenarios.
rationale: Separates evidence from scenario selection and follows the user's instruction to install only the median.
notes: p10 is drier than the reference in both projection windows, so sign uncertainty remains visible.

statement: Represent 20-year CMIP6 climatologies at midpoint years 2030 and 2050, linearly interpolate annual multipliers, and continue the 2030-2050 slope through 2053.
rationale: OSeMOSYS requires annual values while CCKP publishes period climatologies; the interpolation is transparent and reproducible.
notes: This is a modeling assumption, not an annual forecast.

statement: Apply the combined ERA5 rebase and SSP2-4.5 multiplier to precipitation IAR and surface-water, groundwater and evapotranspiration OARs for all eight coefficient classes and all 30 modes.
central_value: same annual factor on four water ratios
rationale: Preserves each inherited mode's hydrological split and closure ratio while moving the national water envelope with precipitation.
notes: AGRWATPHL irrigation coefficients are not scaled.

statement: Use 125.79 km3/year surface-water potential and 20.2 km3/year groundwater potential as national annual gross-withdrawal sensitivity ceilings.
rationale: These are the available national planning figures and are explicitly labeled potential-flow sensitivities; the PSA abstraction account is retained only to disclose the differing boundary.
notes: They are not dependable yield, environmental-flow-adjusted availability, aquifer stock or safe yield.

statement: Scale both national potential-flow ceilings with the same SSP2-4.5 annual precipitation multiplier used for hydrology.
rationale: Provides a transparent climate-linked national sensitivity in the absence of a calibrated runoff/recharge response model.
notes: This proportional response is an assumption and should be replaced by hydrological modeling when available.

statement: Require DEMAGRGWTPHL to consume one unit of PHL_WTR_GWT for each unit of irrigation-water activity in its single active mode.
rationale: Technology activity and raw-water commodity share the same 10^9 m3 unit; the 1:1 pass-through closes the missing physical link.
notes: Existing pumping-electricity input is retained; pumping energy and lift are not recalibrated.

statement: Put water coefficients and constraint values in SC_0 BASE and preserve null/inheritance rows for COAL_PHASEOUT, RE and EV scenarios.
rationale: Preserves existing scenario semantics and prevents duplicated hard-coded policy data.
notes: All four existing scenarios remain; no water scenario is added.

statement: Do not initialize groundwater storage, head, depletion or aquifer-specific recharge because available evidence does not support those states in this one-region model.
rationale: National potential flow and categorical maps cannot be converted to stored volume or safe yield without aquifer geometry, thickness, storage coefficient, head and discharge data.
notes: The local MUIO formulation fixes StorageLevelYearStart to zero and is not used as groundwater stock.

statement: Use the full-precision post-solve national_water_ledger.json as the authoritative water publication; treat ENV_WATER activity as an unforced zero-cost diagnostic only.
rationale: The existing ENV_WATER terminal is not solver-forced and may take arbitrary cost-degenerate activity.
notes: The ledger reconstructs flows from CBC activities, EBb4 balances, UDC rows and duals.
